span.p:
Dokploy → Logs
cari baris error terakhir
cek Domain port 8000

div.style: color: rgb(27, 42, 58) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Menu samping · Reasoning engine
menampilkan gemini-2.5-flash ?

div.style: color: rgb(107, 38, 32) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Cek nama env persis GEMINI_API_KEY
lalu Deploy ulang

div.style: color: rgb(27, 42, 58) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Menu samping · Last fetch
titik hijau, jam ≤ 10 menit lalu ?

div.style: color: rgb(107, 38, 32) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Watchlist → lihat kotak bawah
diblokir? galat? → cek jaringan server

div.style: color: rgb(107, 38, 32) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Cek SENTINEL_TARIK_OTOMATIS_DETIK
atau tekan Check now

div.style: color: rgb(27, 42, 58) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(107, 38, 32) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Cek SENTINEL_KODE_AKSES
dan kode di tautan

div.style: color: rgb(27, 42, 58) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Alerts · buka kasus contoh 2330 18 Sep
TERBIT, 8/8 cek lolos ?

span.p:
Jejak audit kasus itu
Model calls ≥ 1 atau cache ≥ 1 ?

div.style: color: rgb(107, 38, 32) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Kunci Gemini belum terbaca,
atau kuota/kunci ditolak:
lihat sebab cadangan di jejak

div.style: color: rgb(27, 42, 58) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Cari 2330 di menu samping
tab Financials menampilkan tabel ?

div.style: color: rgb(107, 38, 32) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Kuota habis: isi FINMIND_TOKEN
atau tunggu 1 jam

div.style: color: rgb(27, 42, 58) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Tab Valuation emiten selain 2330
menampilkan DCF otomatis ?

div.style: color: rgb(107, 38, 32) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Tekan Check now untuk memanaskan
valuasi watchlist, cek log FinMind

jawaban bersumber ?
